dvids.title: The Last to Stand the Watch: The Sunset of the USS Georgia (SSGN 729)
dvids.desc:
USS Georgia’s final chapter is being written by the sailors who called her home.
"For the last time ever, surface, surface, surface," said Senior Chief Machinist’s Mate Auxiliary John Edwards, his voice carrying through the ship's general announcing system.
